title: 第21章 麻烦上门第22章 她能给我作证
lines: 唐明宽慰道：“柳姨，要不你先去休息，或许明天事情就有转机了。”
“没事的小明，我还不累，再继续找找。”
柳晴温柔开口。
旁边的陈思琪撇撇嘴，不满道：“我说唐明，我妈已经很累了，你能不能别来打扰她。”
唐明微微皱眉：“我没打扰柳姨，我只是想说明天事情有转机，我能帮上忙。”
“你就吹牛吧，你能帮上什么忙？”
陈思琪满脸讥讽：“我发现你这人特别爱吹牛，那可是两千万的欠款，你怎么帮忙？你要是有这能力怎么还来投奔我妈？”
“唐明，你要是没事就回自己房间，别在这打扰我妈想问题。”
柳晴推了推女儿，皱眉道：“怎么说话的，小明再怎么说也是你表哥，说话注意分寸。”
“本来就是嘛，都这个时候了他还吹牛。”
陈思琪满脸委屈的嘀咕：“本来还有半个月的缓解时间，可那天他直接动手打人，害得你缓解时间都没了，银行限期一个星期把钱补上……”
“陈思琪！”
柳晴提高了声音，训斥道：“你也知道我最近烦心事多，怎么还让妈烦心？小明也是关心我安慰我，注意自己的态度。”
看到母亲发火，陈思琪委屈的跑回自己房间。
柳晴皱了下眉头：“这孩子，就是被她爸惯的，小明你别介意。”
“柳姨，没事的。”
唐明微微摇头，和柳姨寒暄了几句，接着回到自己房间开始修炼。
第二天，唐明独自前往学校。
结果刚走进教室，就发现不少人看自己的目光很奇怪，有惊奇、有佩服，更多的还是不敢置信。
因为。
许杰被人废掉，到现在还住在医院的事情传到了学校。
不仅是许杰，连同樊晨在内的十几名社会人员，全部都被废掉！
同桌王冲焦急询问：“唐哥，你，你真的废掉了许杰？”
“你们听谁说的？”唐明有些诧异。
“刚才许杰家长来闹事了，说要打断你的腿给许杰报仇，现在被老师拉去办公室安慰了。”
王冲语气有些担忧：“唐哥，许杰家里面有些不讲道理，你还是把你家长也叫过来吧。”
许杰的家长？
唐明眉头一皱。
正在这时，班主任黄老师出现在门口：“唐明，你出来一下，其他人继续自习。”
唐明神色从容的出去。
他一走，教室里顿时喧闹起来。
“真的假的，唐明真的把许杰打废了？”
“应该是真的，他家长都过来闹事了。”
“我去，这唐明这么猛，还把樊晨等十几混混都给废掉，太狠了。”
“我倒觉得是件好事，许杰在学校里欺凌弱小，很多人都被他敲诈过。”
“现在人家家长过来闹事，唐明估计要倒霉了……”
班上同学议论纷纷。
陈思琪自然也知道了这件事，先是震惊唐明能够废掉许杰樊晨，但随后又很焦急。
content_en:
Tang Ming said comfortingly: "Aunt Liu, why don't you go and rest first, maybe things will turn around tomorrow."
"It's okay, Xiao Ming. I'm not tired yet. Let's continue looking."
Liu Qing spoke softly.
Chen Siqi next to her curled her lips and said dissatisfied: "Tang Ming, my mother is very tired. Can you please stop disturbing her."
Tang Ming frowned slightly: "I didn't bother Aunt Liu, I just wanted to say that things will turn around tomorrow and I can help."
"Just brag, how can you help?"
Chen Siqi's face was full of sarcasm: "I found that you are very fond of bragging. That's a debt of 20 million. How can you help? If you have such ability, why do you come to join my mother?"
"Tang Ming, if you have nothing to do, go back to your room. Don't disturb my mother's thinking here."
"Siqi..."
Liu Qing pushed her daughter, frowned and said, "What are you talking about? Xiao Ming is still your cousin no matter what you say, so be careful when speaking."
"It's true, but now he's still bragging."
Chen Siqi muttered with aggrieved face: "Originally, there was still half a month of relief time, but that day he directly hit someone, causing you to lose all the relief time. The bank has a deadline of one week to make up the money..."
"Chen Siqi!"
Liu Qing raised her voice and reprimanded: "You also know that I have a lot of troubles recently, why do I still make my mother worried? Xiao Ming also cares about me and comforts me. Pay attention to your attitude."
Seeing her mother getting angry, Chen Siqi ran back to her room aggrievedly.
Liu Qing frowned: "This child is spoiled by her father, Xiao Ming, don't mind."
"Aunt Liu, it's okay."
Tang Ming shook his head slightly, exchanged a few words with Aunt Liu, and then returned to his room to start practicing.
…
The next day, Tang Ming went to school alone.
As a result, as soon as I walked into the classroom, I found that many people looked at me strangely, some were surprised, some admired, and most of them were still in disbelief.
because.
The news that Xu Jie was crippled and is still living in the hospital spread to the school.
Not only Xu Jie, but also more than a dozen social workers including Fan Chen were all abolished!
Wang Chong, his deskmate, asked anxiously: "Brother Tang, you, did you really destroy Xu Jie?"
"Who did you listen to?" Tang Ming was a little surprised.
"Xu Jie's parents came to make trouble just now and said they would break your legs to avenge Xu Jie. Now the teacher takes you to the office to comfort you."
Wang Chong sounded worried: "Brother Tang, there are some unreasonable things in Xu Jie's family. You'd better call your parents over."
Xu Jie’s parents?
Tang Ming frowned.
At this moment, the head teacher, Teacher Huang, appeared at the door: "Tang Ming, come out for a moment while the others continue to study."
Tang Ming went out calmly.
As soon as he left, the classroom suddenly became noisy.
"Really or not, Tang Ming really crippled Xu Jie?"
"It should be true, his parents came over to make trouble."
"Let me go, this Tang Ming is so fierce, and he has destroyed Fan Chen and a dozen other gangsters. It's too cruel."
"I think it's a good thing. Xu Jie bullies the weak in school, and many people have been blackmailed by him."
"Now that other parents are here to make trouble, Tang Ming will probably be in trouble..."
The classmates were talking a lot.
Chen Siqi naturally also knew about this. She was shocked at first that Tang Ming could destroy Xu Jie and Fan Chen, but then she became anxious.
title_en: Chapter 21 Trouble is coming Chapter 22 She can testify for me
